snippet.title: Monolith: Rogue TD | Reveal Trailer | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Fall From the Sky and Conquer as the Villain in Monolith: Rogue TD! A dark, stylish roguelike tower defense game coming soon to PC and Nintendo Switch.

Wishist now on Steam: https://bit.ly/Monolith_WishlistNow

Tate Multimedia and Progress_Check are thrilled to unveil Monolith: Rogue TD, a twisted roguelike tower defense game coming to PC and Nintendo Switch. In this genre-bending title, players don’t save the world—they consume it. You are the Monolith: an unbreakable force of corruption crashing down from the heavens, reshaping entire worlds in your own villainous image. With evolving battlefields, strategic tower placement, and powerful upgrade choices, Monolith challenges players to outsmart waves of defenders and reshape every world in their dark image

Follow Monolith: Rogue TD on Socials and Join our Discord!
